approach.eyebrow: CHAPTER I • THE OLD TRADE ROAD
approach.title: The Watchfire
paragraphs: West of the Dales, the harbour city of Seabrook grows rich on dwarven ore, precious metals and gemstones. Lately the mines have sent irregular loads, though their representatives insist the workings are sound. Tavian Marr, a merchant on the Old Trade Road, has commissioned Alden, Elyra, Brunna and Pip to discover why his caravans have stopped reaching the coast.

The roads have always been dangerous. A cheap swordsman and a hedge-mage are usual protection; prosperous merchants may hire a priest besides. Bandits and goblins take their chances, yet a driver or guard ordinarily escapes to tell the tale. Lately entire caravans have disappeared, with no wagons, no cargo and no survivors.

The contract requires a report to the Adventurers' Guild at Harrowford, a small market town on the northern edge of the Dales. Beyond the settled valleys lie wild woods, high moors and limestone hills riddled with old passages.

Tonight the four companions rest in shadow around a small fire beneath dark pines. At dawn they find a covered wagon abandoned on the road. A second campfire is still warm, goblin tracks mark the mud, and somewhere through the trees a bowstring creaks.

victory.title: The Road Falls Silent
paragraphs: The fighting ceases. The goblins lie dead or incapacitated, and the clearing grows quiet except for the crackle of the abandoned fire.
Beneath an overturned chest the party recovers a little coin. There is no worthwhile equipment to carry away.

Whoever attacked this wagon left tracks towards the woods. The trail may lead towards the missing caravans, but the contract also requires a report to the Adventurers' Guild at Harrowford. The clearing can be revisited once overland exploration is implemented.

defeat.title: The Road Takes Its Toll
paragraphs: The goblins reclaim the clearing. The journey towards the Azure Mines ends at this broken wagon.
The party may try the approach again with a different deployment.

aftermath.title: The Road Beyond
paragraphs: The Old Trade Road winds on towards Harrowford and the mines beyond. For all the wealth carried over its worn stones, the settlements still feel small amid the hills and woodland.
Later, the overland map will allow you to return here, search for the raiders' trail, or continue towards the town. The narrative travel choices are planned and not yet playable.

commission.purpose: Investigate unusually complete disappearances of escorted caravans carrying dwarven ore, precious metals and gems between the Dales and western Seabrook
commission.contract_objective: Report to the Adventurers' Guild in Harrowford and investigate losses along the Old Trade Road
